summary: LifeStance Health Group filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and, under Item 8.01, announced a new $100 million share repurchase program approved by the Board on August 5, 2026, replacing a prior $100 million program from February 2026. Repurchases may occur via open market, private negotiations, ASRs, or block trades at the company's discretion, with no obligation to buy a specific amount. The filing includes a press release and supplemental slide presentation. Watch for execution pace and potential EPS support, though no timeline or price terms were specified.
